lore_items.name: Old Empire Katana
lore_items.description:
A plain katana, kept oiled by a hand that never swung it. The edge is better than it has any right to be.

Someone's father carried it a long way once.

lore_items.name: Mended Longcoat
lore_items.description:
A long leather coat, patched at the elbows and re-stitched along every seam by someone with more patience than thread.

It turns a blade a little better than it looks like it should.
